issues.description: Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents() is specified in the problem statement/UML to return an int, but the reference solution implements it to return StudentCount. This makes the required method signature unclear and will cause student implementations that follow the statement (returning int) to differ from the reference design and any code that expects StudentCount (e.g., calls to getValue()).
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the API across all artifacts: either (A) change the solution (and any tests) so getTotalNumberOfStudents() returns int and update callers accordingly (remove StudentCount usage), or (B) update problem_statement.md (text + UML) to specify StudentCount as the return type and add/introduce StudentCount in the template so students can implement the required signature.
